 Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 346-555-2185
 Settlement Demand
9-29-25
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1009 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
We wirte to present the bodily injury claim of our client, David May, arising from the collision of 11-20-23. Our client
was making a left turn at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of her car. The impact
was forceful enough to deploy the airbag and cause her head to snap forward and back, resulting in a diagnosis of
whiplash injury to the neck and upper back.
Since the accident, our client has undergone physical therapy and has been treated by her primary care physician.
She has experienced persistent neck stiffness, headaches, and reduced range of motion, which have interfered with
her work and her ability to care for her family. Her medical records and treatment notes are enclosed for your review.
The liability picture is clear. Your insured failed to yield while approaching the intersection and had the opportunity to
avoid the collision. Our client bore no responsibility for the crash.
Based on the medical evidence, the ongoing treatment, and the lost income documented in the enclosed materials,
we demand payment of $43,000.00 to resolve this claim in full. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date
of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further
notice.
Expert review: Christian Carter, pain management physician
Sincerely,
Carlos Fox
Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
